change_summary: Native game-origin menu/car/race full-frame output now supports disjoint partial D3D9 dirty-region rectangles with per-tile GPU uploads; gap pixels and original D3D9/gamepad fallback remain unchanged.

feature_contract.goal: Extend same-Present native full-resolution game Draw/DrawIndexed publication to multiple partially dirty D3D9 Present rectangles without replacing any untouched pixel or gameplay input.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: 2-8 disjoint partially dirty rectangles are clipped to D3D9 Present source and each gets an exact pixel copy and UpdateSurface.
Missing, overlapping, forged-bound, oversized or off-crop rects reject native publication; all pixels between uploaded tiles and gamepad behavior stay D3D9-owned.
Portable pixel C++ tests, destructive source binding regressions and exact SHA DX11 Fast/Backend/Windows/OpenXR/HUD actions succeed.

development_strategy.visible_frame_acceptance: Eligible native menu/vehicle/race frames are published into exact 2-8 source-clipped partial dirty tiles; unsupported states preserve D3D9/pad.
development_strategy.activation_guard_and_fallback: Full opt-in disabled by default; invalid/overlap/short region, unsupported Draw, failed staging/map/lock/UpdateSurface preserves game D3D9 Present and gamepad with HMD untested.
integration_path: Game intercepted Draw/DrawIndexed -> guarded native full frame
Verify 2-8 disjoint D3D9 Present partial dirty tiles and current source crop
Same-Present D3D11 readback -> per-tile pitched BGRA copy and per-tile D3D9 UpdateSurface
batch_components: DX11-D3D9 real Present native multi-rect C++ publishing
Region contract and portable C++ pixel probe
Destructive regression and DX11 Fast workflow acceptance

acceptance_proof.positive_probe: Portable C++17 selector and two-tile pitched BGRA copy preserving hole bytes
acceptance_proof.negative_regression: Overlapping, mismatched bounds, invalid count/size, offscreen and unmapped crop negative cases; source mutation tests guard per-tile UpdateSurface path
acceptance_proof.component_integration: D3D9 game Present partitionRects -> GameNativeMultiDirtyUpload -> D3D11 native readback -> D3D9 mapped upload exact tiles -> each UpdateSurface without hole overwrite
